title: Pancake Hat
premise: A bear chef flips a pancake. It sticks to the ceiling. He waits. It drops onto the cat as a perfect beret, syrup and all.

characterLean: Breakfast cutaway. The cat's flat face is a nod to the show's deadpan, but the bear is all joy.
